covered_store_ids.description: Store IDs covered by this signed document (for owners with multiple stores)

file_uri.description: URI of the uploaded file (template or signed copy)

signed_at.description: When the signed copy was uploaded

signed_by_name.description: Name of the person who signed

signed_from_version.description: Version of the template this was signed from

signature_image_uri.description: URI of signature image if digitally signed (null for physical signatures)

status.description: template = blank template, signed = uploaded signed copy

store_owner_id.description: AppUser ID of the store owner who signed (null for templates)

uploaded_at.description: When the template or signed copy was uploaded
